title: Diagnosing and Mitigating Long-Session Degradation in Full-Duplex Speech Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.34991v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: End-to-end full-duplex spoken dialogue models enable natural, real-time spoken interactions with interruptions, backchannels, and overlapping speech. Prior evaluations have assessed diverse interaction capabilities and identified some degradation patterns across conversational turns. However, how model behavior evolves over extended sessions remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we address this gap by systematically characterizing long-session degradation and developing efficient methods to mitigate it. We introduce a closed-loop evaluation framework for long-session stability and apply it to several publicly available full-duplex speech models, revealing degradation over time in responsiveness, spoken content quality, and voice consistency. To mitigate this degradation, we propose a self-distillation-based training framework for lightweight LoRA adaptation that improves long-session stability with a small amount of additional

translated_title: 诊断与缓解全双工语音模型中的长会话性能退化
translated_abstract: 端到端全双工语音对话模型能够实现自然的实时语音交互，支持打断、附和反馈以及语音重叠。先前的评估工作已经考察了多样化的交互能力，并识别出一些跨对话轮次的性能退化模式。然而，模型行为在长会话中如何演变仍缺乏充分的理解。在本工作中，我们通过系统性地刻画长会话性能退化并开发高效的缓解方法来填补这一空白。我们引入了一个面向长会话稳定性的闭环评估框架，并将其应用于多个公开可用的全双工语音模型，揭示了模型在响应性、语音内容质量和声音一致性方面随时间的退化。为了缓解这种退化，我们提出了一种基于自蒸馏的训练框架，用于轻量级LoRA适配，仅需少量额外的数据即可提升长会话稳定性。
tldr: 本文提出一个闭环评估框架系统性诊断全双工语音模型在长会话中的性能退化，并提出基于自蒸馏的轻量级LoRA适配训练方法来有效缓解该退化。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a closed-loop evaluation framework to systematically diagnose long-session degradation in full-duplex speech models and proposes a self-distillation-based lightweight LoRA adaptation training framework to effectively mitigate it.
